Quarterly standardized GPR and the quarterly change in log REER

Each chart is one emerging economy. The blue line is the average of monthly standardized GPR during the calendar quarter, measured on the left axis. The rust line is the sum of the monthly changes in log REER during that quarter, measured on the right axis. Both lines are on the same chart. The correlation next to the country name is the Pearson correlation of those two quarterly series.

Each quarter has all three months. 2000Q1 is omitted because the January log-REER change is blank, so the charts run from 2000Q2 through 2023Q4. Source: cleaned/replication_cleaned/country_month.csv.
